value.rationale: The initiating simulations report divergent outcomes without identifying the complete initial-condition partition. A sharp algebraic barrier plus exact curvature of the basin separator resolves the motivated question of who converges where; the continuum of resource states reveals hidden ecological memory despite behavioral convergence.
